description: This file defines the EmbedImages class responsible for embedding images within content by processing HTML tags, resolving image paths, and optionally replacing image URLs via callbacks.

classes.name: EmbedImages
classes.description: Provides functionality for processing HTML content to embed images, modifying image tags, and resolving image paths.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmbedImages instance with a reference to the documentation tree.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Processes a given page's HTML content to embed images, possibly replacing image URLs using a callback.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Extracts attributes from an HTML image tag.

methods.name: findImage
methods.description: Finds and potentially replaces image sources based on their paths, handling external URLs and local paths.
